snippet.title: Elementallis Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Elementallis on Steam at https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304280/Elementallis/

Top-down action adventure with elemental magic gameplay. Guilt pushes you on a journey to restore the elements in a pre-apocalyptic world. Use and combine your elemental powers to fight and solve puzzles across the temples.

Trailer music by Raúl Sangonzalo -   / raul-sangonzalo  


Links of interest:
Discord:   https://discord.com/invite/elementallis
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304280/Elementallis/
